lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a discernible multi-row grid along the lateral midline posterior to the gills, with approximately equidistant horizontal spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a localized grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature exhibits a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high luminance above, low luminance shadow below), running longitudinally from the post-branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a low-density distribution of small high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the basal and posterior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a transition from the organized lateral grid to a dense, stochastic distribution of smaller, lower-intensity pixel clusters across the rostrum.
